## Checklist

- [ ] `flutter analyze` reports **no issues**
- [ ] `flutter test` passes
- [ ] Follows the **design contract** in `CLAUDE.md` (dark minimal, brutalist
      radii/borders, **JetBrains Mono for all numbers/timecodes**, acid orange
      only for active elements)
- [ ] No mock data leaks into the live app (mocks stay behind `--dart-define=MOCK=true`)
- [ ] No secrets/tokens committed (client_id is scraped at runtime; tokens live in secure storage)
- [ ] Updated docs (README / `CLAUDE.md`) if behavior or architecture changed
